::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 2nd [1877]  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

[Sir](people/person_712.qmd)
I am afraid you must tell me again of what poems you want to know the authorship.  I am from home and I destroyed your letter, but all I remember seeing on the list you sent me were from the [Lyra Innocentium](other_books/otherbook_232.qmd), and were [Mr Keble](people/person_798.qmd)’s   I return home on the 5th, but if you write sooner my address is Tyntesfield, Bristol[^1]

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY stayed at Tyntesfield, leaving on 19 August 1872 to go to Spring Hill: Guildhall Library MS 11,021, v 19 f 597, William Gibbs to Henry Gibbs (19 August 1872).
